title: Signature Study — Phase-contrast microscope concept (100x 10x)
description: This is a Signature-authored optical design study for a phase-contrast microscope at 100x 10x. Design goals address the real aberration profile: Field curvature: the focal surface curves instead of lying flat across the field. Axial chromatic aberration: colors focus at different depths in the specimen. Corrected with an apochromatic (APO) design using ED glass. Intended application: materials inspection.

aberration_notes: Field curvature: the focal surface curves instead of lying flat across the field.
Axial chromatic aberration: colors focus at different depths in the specimen.
spec.correction_note: Corrected with an apochromatic (APO) design using ED glass.
